purpose: Future server-side publication detection; no browser polling or automatic scientific approval

sources.candidateCheckCadence: weekly, if an authorized server-side monitor is later enabled
sources.review: Verify publication version, DOI, source table and correction notices; retain report digest
Do not overwrite a historical snapshot; publish a newly named correction version
Framework context, not a substitute for an assessment source table
Visualization conventions and artwork attribution; never use mixed-year illustrative text to replace assessment measurements

workflow: Detect new official publication or correction
Store candidate provenance and original report checksum outside public source
Extract quantities with page locators; AI assistance is untrusted
Validate schema, units, comparators, ranges, normalization, observation periods and source-version consistency
Master Admin authorizes a new immutable assessment version
Explicitly approved release updates latest pointer and integrity manifest

adminIntegration.authentication: Existing server/auth.mjs verified server session and exact super-admin identity; never trust a local Admin flag
adminIntegration.writes: Future endpoints must be explicitly allowed by server/request-policy.mjs and enforce existing unsafe-method/origin checks
adminIntegration.audit: Record candidate, old/new digests, scientific reviewer, approving admin, timestamps and release authorization
adminIntegration.separation: Independent from Earth’s Fever simulation; no client-side credentials, write endpoint or scheduler added
